title: Whether ActiveSG credits can be used at more sports facilities, including community clubs
asked: Mr Yip Hon Weng asked whether the Ministry will widen the use of ActiveSG credits beyond facilities currently under ActiveSG, naming community centres and The Kallang, so residents have more flexibility and take part in sport more widely.
response: Ms Goh Hanyan said ActiveSG credits can be used at all ActiveSG sports facilities, including ActiveSG's World Aquatics Championship Arena at The Kallang, and at community sport facilities in Our Tampines Hub and Senja-Cashew Community Club, and can offset the cost of ActiveSG and Active Health programmes. She said that since November 2025 the credits can also be used at more than 370 school sports facilities under the Dual-Use Scheme. She said SportSG will keep exploring ways to expand their use at more public sports facilities. In reply to the follow-up, she said SportSG is enhancing the My ActiveSG+ booking system first, before working on expanding the use of ActiveSG credits for People's Association facilities.
